name: Kuzushiji-MNIST (KMNIST)
description: Kuzushiji-MNIST is a drop-in replacement for the MNIST dataset featuring 10 classes of cursive Japanese characters (Kuzushiji). Created by the Center for Open Data in the Humanities (CODH), it consists of 70,000 28x28 grayscale images (60,000 training, 10,000 testing) derived from digitized classical Japanese literature.
